visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A sturdy man with a short haircut, wearing a black Under Armour t-shirt and black athletic shorts, stands inside a bright orange power rack. He positions a barbell loaded with green and black Eleiko weight plates across his shoulders. Behind him, a taller spotter in a white vest and black shirt stands ready. The setting is a professional gym with grey concrete-textured walls and bright, even overhead lighting. (2) The lifter performs a series of explosive squats. The visual sequence is characterized by rapid jump cuts that synchronize his movements with the rhythm of the music. His face shows intense concentration with clenched teeth and focused eyes during the exertion. The heavy barbell visibly oscillates as he bursts upward from each squat position. (3) After the final repetition, the man stands tall and carefully racks the weighted barbell onto the orange hooks. The spotter observes the successful completion and then steps aside. The lifter exhales and walks forward toward the camera, his facial expression relaxing into a look of accomplishment as he exits the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy disco-pop track featuring a bright brass arrangement and a driving percussion section. The mix is studio-quality with a high spectral centroid, emphasizing the clarity of the musical instruments and the rhythmic kick drum. No environmental noise or human speech is audible at this stage. (2) The music continues as the sole audio element, maintaining a consistent tempo of roughly 126 BPM. The sonic texture is clean and tonal, dominated by major-mode harmonies. There are no grunts, breathing sounds, or mechanical noises from the gym equipment audible beneath the loud musical bed. (3) As the music reaches a natural phrasing point, a sharp metallic 'clank' occurs as the barbell makes contact with the rack. This is immediately followed by a dull, low-frequency thud. A very faint, low-volume male exhale is briefly audible just before the track ends, indicating physical relief.

The goal is to provide a humorous and energetic showcase of strength, leveraging the contrast between the intense effort of squatting and the joyful mood of the background music.
